gpio.profile_name: X30 discovery: released DRIVE GPIO2.11 and FUNCTION2 GPIO11.0; focus selector S uses GPIO3.6 high / GPIO3.7 low (C: high/high; M: low/high); Q, shutter and remaining inputs borrowed from X-E2S REC.

power.profile_name: X30 discovery: normal boot class0x40, ring contact enabled in MCU60 bit0, ADC9=0 selects RING_ON and ADC3=640 selects PROGRAM; analog control ring ADC6/7=750 starts high/high, with synthetic 250/750 phase levels around calibrated 494/506 Schmitt thresholds and unmeasured 120000-tick spacing; remaining inputs borrowed.

storage_slots.basis: X30 specifications: one SD card slot (UHS-I).
